say:2:1536128501:1.text: Hardest thing I've ever done! And this year was the worst!

say:3:1536128502:1.text: Can't blame them. The Hunting Goddess hasn't returned in years. They had to make it count...
say:3:1536128502:1.source_cn: 毕竟狩猎神大人隔了十几年才降临这一次……
say:3:1536128502:1.male: Can't blame them. The Hunting Goddess hasn't returned in years. They had to make it count...
say:3:1536128502:1.female: Can't blame them. The Hunting Goddess hasn't returned in years. They had to make it count...

say:4:1536128503:1.text: Next time, my son will go. Even if he falls at the Bloodhunt, it would be an honor for our whole family!
say:4:1536128503:1.source_cn: 下次只能让我儿子去了，哪怕他战死在猎血节，也是我们全家...
